## What changed?

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests/checks, or explained why they could not be run.
- [ ] I did not claim an APK build or device test unless it actually completed.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No API keys, access tokens, passwords, signing keys, keystores, or private certificates are included.
- [ ] No secrets are exposed through `VITE_*` or other browser-visible variables.
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, and user-consent boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] Existing Android/web behavior and supported fallbacks are preserved.
- [ ] Any new permissions, network access, or third-party SDKs are explained.

## Review

- [ ] Changes are ready for owner review; do not merge directly to `main` without checking the diff and verification status.
